description: The bar chart illustrates average performance values for five methods associated with “Context-Informed Grounding Supervision,” showing one bar per method. The horizontal axis contains the categorical method labels in left-to-right order: Standard, Self-RAG, FactTune, ClnGS (w/), and ClnGS. The vertical axis is labeled “Average Performance” and uses a linear scale ranging from 0 to 60, with regularly spaced tick marks at 10-unit intervals. Each category is represented by a single solid-colored bar: Standard is a brown bar at approximately 52, Self-RAG is an olive/gray bar at approximately 54, FactTune is a green bar at approximately 51–52, ClnGS (w/) is a blue-gray bar at approximately 54, and ClnGS is a dark blue bar at approximately 59–60. The bars are not stacked or grouped beyond the single-series layout, there is no legend shown, the categories appear in a fixed labeled order rather than being explicitly sorted by value, and no bars are visually emphasized with outlines or annotations.
